We've always had a soft spot for GRID Legends, whether we're playing on current-gen consoles, mobile or now on Switch 2. It's a striking-looking game that plays beautifully. So... how does the Switch 2 version stack up against the PS4 and Xbox Series S versions - and what's the score with six modes (plus adjustable options) across the docked and handheld configurations?
